text: Alice pins Python dependencies with uv and never uses pip directly.
Alice prefers Neovim over graphical editors for all editing work.
Alice wants all code comments and commit messages written in English.
Alice reviews plans in a conversation before any code is written.
Alice runs every Python project inside a virtual environment, never system-wide.
Alice's preferred commit subject style is short imperative mood under 72 characters.
Alice keeps Docker images multi-stage with a builder and a runtime layer.
Alice refuses COPY dot dot in Dockerfiles because it ships git history and secrets.
Alice reads documentation through Context7 and DeepWiki before trusting project docs.
Alice wants unrelated dead code mentioned but never deleted without asking.
Bob pins Python dependencies with Poetry and distrusts newer resolvers.
Bob uses VS Code with the Vim extension and dislikes terminal editors.
Bob writes commit messages in Spanish for his internal projects.
Bob prefers single-stage Dockerfiles for speed on his laptop.
Bob installs Python packages globally with pip on his development machine.
Bob skips the design discussion and asks for code immediately.
Bob deletes unreferenced code on sight without flagging it first.
Bob keeps long descriptive commit subjects well over a hundred characters.
The payments service stores idempotency keys for exactly 24 hours.
The payments service settles in EUR and rejects any other settlement currency.
Payments runs its database migrations as a pre-install hook before the API starts.
The payments refund endpoint is asynchronous and returns an operation to poll.
Payments rate limits each API credential to 100 writes per minute.
The payments staging cluster runs in eu-west-1 and production runs in eu-central-1.
Payments never logs the full card number, only the last four digits.
The payments team requires two approvals on any merge request touching settlement.
The search service stores idempotency keys for exactly 7 days.
The search service indexes documents in USD-denominated catalogues only.
Search runs its migrations lazily on first request rather than before startup.
The search reindex endpoint is synchronous and blocks until the index is rebuilt.
Search rate limits each API credential to 1000 reads per minute.
The search staging cluster runs in us-east-1 and production runs in us-west-2.
Search logs every query in full for relevance tuning.
The search team requires one approval on any merge request.
